disclaimer: The Four Temperaments and Emotional Competencies are reflective self-exploration frameworks, not clinical psychological diagnoses. Scores represent self-reported inclinations.

bands.name: Low
bands.interpretation: Less frequently endorsed in everyday behavior; not absent, but less dominant.

bands.name: Moderate
bands.interpretation: Moderately expressed; situational context and conscious choice often shape this tendency.

bands.name: High
bands.interpretation: Prominently endorsed; a habitual reflective style in social, decision-making, or task settings.
